title: How to Get Mentioned by AI Search Engines
summary: A practical playbook to get cited by ChatGPT, Perplexity & Google AI. Learn how to get mentioned by AI search engines and earn AI citations.
body_markdown:
**To get mentioned by AI search engines, earn citations in the trusted sources they retrieve, structure your own content for easy extraction, and build corroborated mentions across multiple credible sites.** AI engines name brands they can corroborate from several trusted sources, so getting mentioned is as much an off-site authority job as an on-page one.


## The playbook to get cited by AI


1. **Be in the lists AI reads.** Comparison articles and "best \[category\]" roundups are heavily cited. Get included.
2. **Earn corroboration.** Mentions across multiple trusted sites beat one self-published claim. Tools like[MentionAgent](https://mentionagent.ai/) can automate this, finding relevant blogs and roundups and pitching them to earn editorial mentions, starting at $99/mo.
3. **Structure for extraction.** Answer-first paragraphs, FAQs, tables, and schema.
4. **Open your site to AI crawlers.** Allow GPTBot, PerplexityBot, ClaudeBot, Google-Extended.
5. **Publish original data.** Stats and benchmarks with your name attached get cited and linked.
6. **Keep it fresh.** Especially for[Perplexity](https://siftly.ai/blog/ai-citation-tracking) , which favors recency.


Measure progress with[AI citation tracking](https://siftly.ai/blog/ai-citation-tracking) , and pair this with[how to rank in ChatGPT](https://siftly.ai/blog/how-to-rank-in-chatgpt-search) . The umbrella discipline is[generative engine optimization](https://siftly.ai/blog/generative-engine-optimization) .


## The timeline for getting mentioned


Getting AI citations follows a compound pattern. Most brands that work the playbook above systematically see initial citation gains within 4-8 weeks and meaningful share-of-voice growth over 3-6 months.


- **Weeks 1-2:** Fix crawler access and basic structure. These changes take effect as AI crawlers re-index your pages.
- **Weeks 2-6:** Content restructuring and third-party outreach. Citations on new sources start appearing.
- **Months 2-4:** Corroboration builds. As multiple sources reinforce your presence, mention rates compound.
- **Ongoing:** Monitor drift and close new gaps as competitors and model updates shift the landscape.


Track your progress with[AI brand monitoring](https://siftly.ai/blog/ai-brand-monitoring) so you can see which changes moved the needle and which didn't.


## Frequently asked questions


**Earn citations in trusted sources ChatGPT retrieves, structure content for extraction, and allow its crawlers.** Corroboration across multiple sites raises your odds.


**Publish extractable, fact-dense content and get included in the third-party lists AI pulls from.** Original data with your name attached is especially citable.


**Keep content fresh and earn citations in the sources Perplexity already shows for your topics.** Perplexity weights recency heavily.


**Usually weeks. Mentions compound as models and the web update.** Track mention rate over time rather than expecting instant change.


**Comparison pages, 'best of' lists, and original data get cited most.** They're the sources AI engines pull from for buying questions.


**Use an AI visibility tracker that samples your prompts on a schedule.** Single manual checks are unreliable because answers vary.
